stem_md: 下列关于 $u=\frac{x}{x^2+y^2+z^2}$ 的偏导数，正确的有(\quad)个。
analysis_md:
(1) $\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\dfrac{y^2+z^2-x^2}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2}$；(2) $\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\dfrac{-2xy}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2}$；(3) $\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial z}=\dfrac{-2xz}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2}$。

\[
\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{x^2+y^2+z^2-x\cdot2x}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2}=\frac{y^2+z^2-x^2}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2},
\]
\[
\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=x\cdot\left(-\frac{2y}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2}\right)=\frac{-2xy}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2},
\]
\[
\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}=x\cdot\left(-\frac{2z}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2}\right)=\frac{-2xz}{(x^2+y^2+z^2)^2}.
\]
